tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind every card and the sidebar. Never use for a card.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sidebar, top bar, popovers, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header band, search field, neutral delta pill, segmented track.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill on rows, nav items and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card borders, table row dividers, chart frame. Decorative: never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls (inputs, secondary buttons, neutral status pill). 3:1 on surface and canvas in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on canvas, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, captions, 'Bulan lalu …', axis labels. 4.5:1 on surface and canvas in both themes.

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Brand weight: Cash Position card, primary button, expense bars, first donut segment.

tokens.name: forest-strong
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill of forest buttons.

tokens.name: forest-line
tokens.usage: Hairline arcs and dividers drawn inside a forest card.

tokens.name: on-forest
tokens.usage: Text and icons on forest.

tokens.name: on-forest-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on forest (labels, breakdown rows).

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: Accent: active nav item, income bars, positive delta pill, accent button. A fill only, never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: lime-strong
tokens.usage: Hover of lime fills; outline of the highlighted chart bar.

tokens.name: on-lime
tokens.usage: Text and icons on lime and lime-strong.

tokens.name: lime-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted chips and avatar ground; text on it is ink.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Positive amounts and 'Lunas' text when it stands alone (no pill). 4.5:1 on surface.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Overdue, failed, negative delta pill fill, '> 90 hari' aging segment.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a danger notice; text on it is ink or danger.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending / diajukan / '31–60 hari'. Text and outline; 4.5:1 on surface and warning-soft.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text on a warning fill.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a warning notice ('Data perlu dicek').

tokens.name: chart-income
tokens.usage: Money in: income bars, inflow segments.

tokens.name: chart-expense
tokens.usage: Money out: expense bars, outflow segments. Lighter in dark so it separates from surface.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Gridlines and the zero line's companions in charts.

tokens.name: chart-axis
tokens.usage: The zero line in diverging charts.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Categorical series 1 (largest share). Text on it: on-chart-1.

tokens.name: on-chart-1
tokens.usage: Text on a chart-1 chip.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Categorical series 2. Text on it: on-lime.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Categorical series 3. Text on it: on-lime.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Categorical series 4. Text on it: on-lime.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Categorical series 5 and 'Lainnya'. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Categorical series 6 (entity donut).

tokens.name: chart-7
tokens.usage: Categorical series 7 (entity donut).

tokens.name: chart-8
tokens.usage: Categorical series 8 (entity donut).

tokens.name: chart-9
tokens.usage: Categorical series 9 (entity donut).

tokens.name: chart-10
tokens.usage: Categorical series 10 (entity donut).

tokens.name: chart-other
tokens.usage: The merged 'Lainnya' segment of the entity donut.

tokens.name: indicator
tokens.usage: Selected-tab underline and selection marks. 3:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring (2px solid, 2px offset) on canvas and surface.

tokens.name: focus-on-forest
tokens.usage: Focus ring for controls placed on a forest card.

families.sans: "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: The one headline number of a KPI card. Tabular figures on.

styles.name: figure-lg
styles.usage: Cash Position on the forest card; chart totals.

styles.name: figure-md
styles.usage: Donut centre, secondary totals inside a card.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per page, in the top bar.

styles.name: kpi-label
styles.usage: The label above a KPI figure.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Row names, emphasised values in tables.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Nav items, buttons, table headers, legend rows, form labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Comparisons under figures, axis ticks, pill text, timestamps.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow on forest cards and grouped nav headings. Write it uppercase in CSS (text-transform).

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Account codes, journal numbers, invoice numbers.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Secondary references under a row name.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text inside pills; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between pill and caption; legend rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Nav item padding; gaps inside toolbars.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gutter between cards; table cell side padding; page side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between KPI label and figure; page padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Status pills, legend percent chips, chart bars.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items, menu rows, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Table header band, popovers, notices.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and the sidebar panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Delta pills, toggles, avatars.

shadow.note: The system is flat: cards use a border, not a shadow. Shadows only lift things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, tooltips.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Halo around the selected bar or point in a chart.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Fixed sidebar column on desktop (≥ 1024px).

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Top bar row height.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, icon buttons.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the main column.
